# Vendored frontend libraries

Self-hosted so the app works offline / air-gapped without CDN access.

| File | Package | Version | Upstream |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `htmx.min.js` | htmx | 2.0.4 | https://unpkg.com/htmx.org@2.0.4/dist/htmx.min.js |
| `jszip.min.js` | JSZip | 3.10.1 | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jszip/3.10.1/jszip.min.js |
| `epub.min.js` | epub.js | 0.3.93 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/epubjs@0.3.93/dist/epub.min.js |

Refresh with the same URLs when bumping versions; keep templates in sync.
